recipes.name: Grilled Salmon with Lentil Tabbouleh
steps: Season salmon fillets with salt, pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil.
Grill salmon 4–5 min per side until cooked through. Rest 2 min.
Cook lentils in salted water until tender (~20 min). Drain and cool.
Combine lentils with diced cucumber, tomato, parsley, mint, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Serve salmon over tabbouleh.
recipes.tips: Swap salmon for chicken breast for a lower-fat version. Lentils can be made a day ahead.

recipes.name: Turkey-Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Cut tops off peppers, remove seeds.
Brown ground turkey with onion, garlic, and Italian seasoning.
Mix in cooked rice, diced tomatoes, and tomato paste. Season to taste.
Stuff peppers with turkey mixture. Place in baking dish.
Top with shredded mozzarella. Bake 30–35 min until peppers are tender.
recipes.tips: Use cauliflower rice instead of white rice to reduce carbs by ~12g per 100g.

recipes.name: Shrimp + Edamame Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
steps: Cook brown rice per package directions.
Heat sesame oil in a wok over high heat.
Stir-fry shrimp 2–3 min until pink. Remove and set aside.
Add edamame, snap peas, and bell pepper. Stir-fry 3–4 min.
Return shrimp to wok. Add soy sauce, ginger, and garlic. Toss to coat.
Serve over brown rice.
recipes.tips: Frozen shrimp work great here — thaw in cold water for 10 min. Edamame is a GLP-1 MVP for protein + fiber.

recipes.name: White Bean + Tuna Salad with Lemon Vinaigrette
steps: Drain and rinse white beans and tuna.
Whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Combine beans, tuna, arugula, red onion, and capers in a large bowl.
Drizzle with vinaigrette and toss gently.
Serve immediately or refrigerate up to 2 days.
recipes.tips: No-cook meal — great for days when appetite is low. High fiber keeps you full longer.

recipes.name: Spiced Chickpea + Chicken Thigh Skillet
steps: Season chicken thighs with cumin, smoked paprika, coriander, salt, and pepper.
Sear chicken in olive oil 4–5 min per side. Remove from pan.
Sauté onion and garlic in the same pan until softened.
Add chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and chicken broth. Stir to combine.
Return chicken to pan. Simmer 15–20 min until cooked through.
Finish with fresh cilantro and a squeeze of lemon.
recipes.tips: Chicken thighs stay moist even when appetite is suppressed. One-pan cleanup.
